'''Kagoshima Shrine''' (鹿児島神社) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine|1=Shinto shrine}} in {{ill|Kagoshima Prefecture|en|Kagoshima Prefecture|qid=Q15701|lt=Kagoshima Prefecture|1=Kagoshima Prefecture}}.

* {{ill|Kagoshima Shrine (Kagoshima City)|ja|鹿児島神社 (鹿児島市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kagoshima Shrine (Kagoshima City)|qq=}} - Located in Kusamuta-chō, {{ill|Kagoshima|en|Kagoshima|qid=Q15674|lt=Kagoshima City|1=Kagoshima}}.
* {{ill|Kagoshima Shrine (Tarumizu City)|ja|鹿児島神社 (垂水市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kagoshima Shrine (Tarumizu City)|qq=}} - Located in Shimomiya-chō, {{ill|Tarumizu, Kagoshima|en|Tarumizu, Kagoshima|qid=Q847591|lt=Tarumizu City|1=Tarumizu, Kagoshima}}.
